comment: Pinned codegen tools for Protocol/app-daemon. make app-daemon-tools downloads each artifact, verifies the SHA-256 digest, and installs the binaries into tmp/app-daemon-tools/bin. Digest mismatch fails the build. Update only with a deliberate tool-version bump recorded in progress/.

protoc_gen_swift.comment: Built from the pinned source archive: swift build -c release --product protoc-gen-swift

protoc_gen_grpc_swift_2.comment: Built from the pinned source archive: swift build -c release --product protoc-gen-grpc-swift-2

rust_toolchain.comment: The Rust toolchain is pinned by rust-toolchain.toml and installed by rustup at first cargo invocation; Cargo.lock pins crate versions.
